mapper.sql: D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.CONTENT, D.DRAFTER_ID, DU.USER_NM AS DRAFTER_NM, D.APPROVER_ID, AU.USER_NM AS APPROVER_NM, D.STATUS, D.SUBMIT_DT, D.APPROVED_DT, D.REJECT_REASON, D.REGIST_DT, D.UPDT_DT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM APPROVAL_DOC D LEFT JOIN APP_USER DU ON DU.USER_ID = D.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER AU ON AU.USER_ID = D.APPROVER_ID WHERE D.DOC_ID = #{docId}

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID, H.DOC_ID, H.ACTION, H.ACTOR_ID, U.USER_NM AS ACTOR_NM, H.NOTE, H.ACTION_DT FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = H.ACTOR_ID WHERE H.DOC_ID = #{docId} ORDER BY H.ACTION_DT, H.HISTORY_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM FROM APP_USER WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY USER_NM, USER_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE APPROVAL_DOC SET DOC_TYPE = #{docType}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE APPROVAL_DOC SET STATUS = 'SUBMITTED', SUBMIT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE APPROVAL_DOC SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', APPROVED_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE APPROVAL_DOC SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, APPROVED_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL_HISTORY (HISTORY_ID, DOC_ID, ACTION, ACTOR_ID, NOTE, ACTION_DT) VALUES (#{historyId}, #{docId}, #{action}, #{actorId}, #{note}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
